name: Grafana Cloud Free
free_limit: Grafana Cloud Free: 10,000 active metric series/month and 50 GB logs ingested/month, with 14-day free retention
watch_out: No credit card for ongoing Free, but metrics, logs, traces, profiles and synthetic tests have separate usage caps. Free retention is 14 days for metrics, logs and traces; Pro starts with a $19/month platform fee plus usage. Do not mistake self-hosted Grafana OSS for free managed ingestion.
